name: Kimi to Mirai
source:
Keichi Mori in the marketing department is told by his chief that he may receive a reward if he could make a certain deal successfully... A boy's love adventure in office.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095048.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
营销部的森圭一被上司告知，只要成功谈成某笔生意，就可能得到奖励…一部以办公室为舞台的男男恋爱冒险游戏。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095048.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
